title: Package Analytics
description: What progress means for one methodology. A package ships this file beside its philosophy.yaml to declare which metric primitives constitute progress for it, over which sessions, against what target. The engine (src/analytics) is a generic interpreter over these declarations; a package with no file gets a spec synthesised from its frameworks' progression models. Every id referenced here must be owned or borrowed by the package — tools/check_provenance.py enforces it.

id.description: Must equal the package directory name and the philosophy id.

progress.description: Ordered. The methodology's own progress signals, first is the most important unless one is marked `headline`.

balance.description: Movement-pattern ratios this methodology cares about. Declared ratios are reported as warnings when outside [min, max]; undeclared ratios are information only — a push:pull warning on a program that deliberately has no pull slot is noise.

a.description: Pattern rollup: push, pull, hinge, squat, carry, locomotion, or a raw pattern id.

benchmarks.description: Benchmark ids to show for this methodology, in addition to any whose `sources` name this package.

primitive.description: One of the engine's metric primitives (src/analytics/primitives). Adding a primitive is an engine change; declaring one is not.

scope.description: Which sessions and which assignments within them feed this entry. Session-level selectors (modalities, archetypes, frameworks) narrow sessions; assignment-level selectors (slot_roles, slot_types, exercises, movement_patterns) narrow the exercises inside them. Empty means everything the program schedules.

frameworks.description: Apply only in weeks governed by these frameworks — how a phased program (Uphill) scopes an entry to one phase.

slot_roles.description: fnmatch globs over the archetype slot role, e.g. "primary_*". Roles are free-form (144 distinct across the packages), so prefer exclude_slot_roles unless you own the archetypes.

exclude_slot_roles.description: fnmatch globs for roles to leave out, e.g. "*warm*", "*accessory*".

expected.description: Where the target comes from. Never a re-run of the generator: the stored program cannot be replayed (api._clean_exercise_assignment strips the slot).

load_field.description: A key of the stored ea.load, e.g. target_rounds, duration_minutes, hold_seconds.

headline.description: The entry the methodology section leads with. At most one; otherwise chosen from the philosophy's progression_philosophy.

sessions.description: Consecutive non-deload sessions without improvement that constitute a stall. Starting Strength: 3.

target_level.description: For benchmark_level: the level this methodology considers its end state.

rpm_target.description: For rate: reps per minute the methodology trains toward.

min_sessions.description: For unlocks: sessions before an exercise counts as practised.
